title: 冗余调整人工年龄评分（AAS）下AI系统的长期持久性理论
summary: 本文提出基于冗余调整AAS的AI系统长期持久性框架，将AAS扩展为循环级函数，证明结构年龄有界，排除爆炸性老化，并定义多种渐近状态，表明无限循环不要求无界老化，为长期持久性提供形式化基础。
summary_en: This paper proposes a long-run persistence framework for AI systems based on redundancy-adjusted AAS, extending it to a cycle-level functional, proving bounded structural age, and defining asymptotic regimes, showing indefinite cycles do not require unbounded aging.
